title: Conditional κ = 0.000724189082265949: gen4 retiming, 440 early restorations and 60 dirty entrances
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Conditional **κ = 724189082265949363570532 / 10^27 = 0.000724189082265949363570532**. This is **+0.08533948% over PR279's 0.000723571590007464**, the strongest public construction claim observed immediately before publication, and +0.18250242% over PR276. PR279 independently published the same 880 common-frame retimings during preparation; the additional gain here comes from composing them with **440 early helper restorations and 60 transported dirty entrances**. No priority or global-optimality claim is made.

The additive package `research/gen4-retiming-entrances/` includes its full immutable PR276 prerequisite (commit `d428ab0462b9dfd3131ab4e89999f0adcd6173dd`), frozen selections, exact emitters, proofs, native chart/column checkers, finite pricer, completed-bank admission and a network-free verifier. No existing construction is modified. Final word SHA256: `71dd08f325566160a01b1c3d8b38450eeb48f478c8f7588065e234d58bddef48`.

The scalar changes are checked signed commuting shears: 440 helper restorations move to legal rank-23 endpoints, while 240 original dirty reads move beyond the last copied-center discard to support 60 larger entrances. The two helper sets are disjoint. Residual ranks tile all width-120 banks exactly at 60 replicas, reducing normalized stock to 255,841. The final chart bound raises the normalizer to **447**, fully included in the finite invoice.

All-size compiler, common weighted chart, restored rows, selectors, routing, prime supply, precision/recovery, complex symbolic correctness and analytic reduction interfaces remain inherited assumptions. This is a conditional finite construction, not an unconditional multiplication theorem, new Lean proof or measured runtime improvement.

## Validation

The published package was freshly replayed from its immutable inputs with Python/SymPy and clang C++17:

- Full unmodified PR276 nine-stage admission and source integrity, followed by actual source regeneration and each transformation.
- 4,400 exact retimed source-span inclusions; signed cleanup/entrance commutation checks; all 23,450 global formal columns, 120 fresh COPY episodes and six nonzero bridge controls.
- 3,784 exact changed projector charts, including every one of the 500 changed helper endpoints; max 208 chart factors, numerator 764 and denominator 351.
- 4,923,000 literal role/replica/stage bank assignments; 2,400 endpoint columns and 2,400 nonzero omission/repetition controls.
- Normalizer 447, selector charge 528,906,962,400, full finite primitive coefficient 92,488,203,535,344,001 and independently recomputed 91-bit signed payload bound.
- Exact q = 2^127 − 1 proof, retained full fallback, two rational moment engines, eight ordinary levels, all 47 strict outer inequalities and adjacent-grid rejection.
- Package input hashes unchanged before/after. Dedicated Linux/g++ workflow included.

```sh
sudo apt-get install -y g++ libboost-dev
python3 -m pip install -r research/gen4-retiming-entrances/requirements.txt
python3 -B research/gen4-retiming-entrances/verify.py --output /tmp/gen4-composed-replay
```

Use a fresh output outside the package. Python 3.11+ and SymPy 1.14.0 are required; no network is used by the verifier.
